speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; I see you are a newborn presenting with seizures and lethargy three days after birth. To begin our assessment, please tell me if there are any known complications during your pregnancy or delivery, and do you have a family history of seizures?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on the low birth weight, history of chorioamnionitis, and low Apgar scores, I suspect sepsis or hypoxic-ischemic injury. To narrow this down, have the infant experienced any fever or poor feeding in the last 48 hours?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, Blood Culture, and CRP.
REQUEST TEST: Blood Glucose and Serum Electrolytes.
REQUEST TEST: Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) analysis if clinically indicated.
